scope: ASME PCC-2-2022 only. PCC-1 and PCC-3 deferred - see deferred_codes.

codes.title: Repair of Pressure Equipment and Piping
codes.source_pdf: ASME PCC-2 REPAIR OF PRESSURE EQUIPMENT AND PIPING.pdf

extraction.source: embedded text layer (born-digital); no OCR applied
extraction.boundaries: embedded PDF outline, refined to the opening SectionHeader block

layout.pattern: pcc_2/<part>/<article>/art_<id>.json, figures in fig/, article-scoped appendices under <article>/app/app_<id>/
layout.naming: Directory and file names are deliberately short. Windows resolves paths against a 260-character limit and the delivery root is already 117 characters; earlier descriptive names produced 421-character paths that Explorer could not open. Longest path here is 213. The full chapter title is preserved in each file's 'chapter_title'.
layout.notes: Every block carries its 1-indexed PDF 'page'. Headers carry the ASME designator in 'number' and a 'level' derived from that designator.

verification.method: Each reconstructed table's cell strings are checked against the source PDF's own text layer for the table's page and the next.

fields.cell_traceability: fraction of cells found verbatim in the source
fields.unsourced_words: words appearing NOWHERE on the source page - non-zero means text was invented and must be reviewed

verification.reading: Low traceability with zero unsourced words means the content is real but columns are split wrongly - check the grid, trust the values.

excluded_from_extraction: cover, title page, copyright and date-of-issuance
table of contents and lists of figures/tables/forms
foreword, committee roster, correspondence with the PCC Committee
IHS/Accuris licensee stamps and reproduction notices
retained_deliberately: all Mandatory and Nonmandatory Appendices - technical content, not back matter, nested under their parent Article
known_limitations: Table structure: 22 tables carry a reconstructed HTML grid; 36 are marked structure='not_reconstructed'. For those, every cell value is present in reading order in 'text', but row/column position is NOT recoverable - do not infer positional meaning from them.
No LLM post-processing. Re-running with --use_llm plus --min_recon_score 0.0 would give the remaining tables real grids; verified on samples at 1.000 cell traceability with zero invented words.
Equations are captured as text from the PDF layer, not as LaTeX.
Appendices marked DELETED in the 2022 edition (401-II, 401-III, 401-V, 401-VI, 401-B, 402-II, 402-III and others) appear as single-block chapters. Faithful to the source, not an extraction failure.
74 ASME revision markers mangled by the source PDF's symbol-font encoding have been normalised to <22> form.

deferred_codes.reason: Scanned (150 DPI images) with a corrupt embedded OCR layer that renders Appendix 'B' as '8'. Needs re-OCR via marker's surya VLM, which requires an inference backend (Docker/vLLM or llama-server) not installed.
deferred_codes.prepared: chapter map derived: 15 sections + 19 appendices (Mandatory I plus Nonmandatory A-R); printed-page to PDF-page offset = +13

deferred_codes.reason: Same as PCC-1 - scanned, corrupt OCR layer, needs a VLM backend.
deferred_codes.prepared: chapter map derived: 16 sections + 6 appendices (A-F); printed-page to PDF-page offset = +11
